title: Transaction
description: Learn how to manage transactions with BEGIN, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK statements.

data.text: A transaction is a single unit of work that typically contains multiple T-SQL statements. If successful, changes are committed; if an error occurs, changes are rolled back.

data.title: Basic transaction pattern
data.content: Starts a transaction, performs operations, and commits.

data.title: Transaction with INSERT and UPDATE
data.content: Creates a transaction that inserts an invoice and its items.

data.title: Transaction Key Points
points: Use BEGIN TRANSACTION to start a transaction explicitly.
Use COMMIT to save changes and ROLLBACK to undo them.
Transactions ensure data consistency and integrity.
SQL Server uses autocommit for single statements by default.
